name: The Haunting of Braidwood Manor
source:
A one-shot mystery story following a woman who attempts to uncover the secrets of a seemingly abandoned estate in order to solve her brother's suicide. 

[Edited from [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:The_Haunting_of_Braidwood_Manor]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
这是一部一次性悬疑故事，讲述了一名妇女试图揭开一处看似废弃的庄园的秘密，以解决她哥哥自杀的问题。

[编辑自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:The_Haunting_of_Braidwood_Manor]Choices Wikia[/url]]
